newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SCA unit buys into Swiss Widmer-Walty.
newsitem.headline: SCA unit buys into Swiss Widmer-Walty.

text.p: Swedish forestry group SCA on Tuesday said its packaging unit was to take part ownership of Swiss packaging and paper company Widmer-Walty through an investment of 100 million crowns.
SCA Packaging said the acquisition was being made in cooperation with Credit Suisse and CS First Boston.
"A separate holding company financed by debt and shareholders' equity, of which SCA will contribute about 100 million crowns, is being formed with a third partner," SCA said in a statement.
"This will give SCA 49 percent of the equity capital in the holding company."
SCA is entitled within five years to acquire the other owners' shares in the holding company.
Widmer-Walty, which is the second biggest player in the corrugated packaging and recycled paper market in Switzerland, also owns 49 percent in Nestler Wellpappe GmbH in Germany.
